4044.note: Loose-meat burgers on West Douglas since 1930.
4044.fn: The Kansas Sampler Foundation's 8 Wonders page: the NuWay tradition began on July 4, 1930, and the original is at 1416 W. Douglas; Visit Wichita (July 2026) lists it open.
